sections.body:
### Exercise 1 — Add a Search Agent
Create a `search_agent` that has a `web_search(query: str)` tool (mock it — return a fake result). Add a `search_web` tool to the router that delegates to it. Test with "search the web for the latest Pydantic AI release notes."

### Exercise 2 — Rate Limit the API
Add `slowapi` to the FastAPI app and cap `/chat` at 10 requests per minute per IP. Return 429 on overflow.

### Exercise 3 — Five-Case Eval for the Email Classifier
Build a `Dataset` of 5 emails (2 urgent, 2 routine, 1 spam) with the expected label as a metadata field. Write a custom `Evaluator` that checks whether the router's response mentions the right sub-agent.

<details>
<summary>Solution 1</summary>

```python
import asyncio
from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext
from router_module import router, RouterDeps

search_agent = Agent(
    "openai:gpt-4o-mini",
    system_prompt="You search the web and summarize the top result.",
)

@search_agent.tool
def web_search(ctx: RunContext[None], query: str) -> str:
    """Mock web search."""
    return f"Top result for '{query}': Pydantic AI v0.x released on 2024-09-01."

@router.tool
async def search_web(ctx: RunContext[RouterDeps], request: str) -> str:
    """Delegate to the search sub-agent."""
    result = await search_agent.run(request)
    return result.data

async def main():
    deps = RouterDeps(user_id="ada")
    result = await router.run(
        "Search the web for the latest Pydantic AI release notes.",
        deps=deps, usage_limit=5,
    )
    print(result.data)

asyncio.run(main())
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Solution 2</summary>

```python
# app.py (extended)
from slowapi import Limiter
from slowapi.util import get_remote_address
from slowapi.errors import RateLimitExceeded
from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

limiter = Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address)
app.state.limiter = limiter

@app.exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded)
async def rate_limit_handler(request: Request, exc: RateLimitExceeded):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=429,
        content={"detail": "Too many requests. Slow down."},
    )

@app.post("/chat")
@limiter.limit("10/minute")
async def chat(request: Request, req: ChatRequest) -> dict:
    deps = RouterDeps(user_id=req.user_id)
    result = await router.run(req.prompt, deps=deps, usage_limit=5)
    return {"response": result.data}
```

`slowapi` requires the `request: Request` parameter (even if unused) so it can identify the client.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Solution 3</summary>

```python
import asyncio
from pydantic_evals import Case, Dataset
from pydantic_evals.evaluators import Evaluator, EvaluatorContext

from router_module import router, RouterDeps

class RoutedToCorrectAgent(Evaluator[str]):
    """Checks the response mentions the expected sub-agent verb."""

    KEYWORDS = {
        "urgent": "email",
        "routine": "email",
        "calendar": "block|schedule|calendar",
        "spam": "ignored|spam",
    }

    def __init__(self, expected_label: str):
        self.expected_label = expected_label

    async def evaluate(self, ctx: EvaluatorContext[str]) -> float:
        import re
        pattern = self.KEYWORDS[self.expected_label]
        return 1.0 if re.search(pattern, ctx.output.lower()) else 0.0

cases = [
    Case(name="urgent_1",
         inputs="URGENT: production is down, email the on-call now.",
         metadata={"label": "urgent"}),
    Case(name="urgent_2",
         inputs="Reply immediately to the customer escalation email.",
         metadata={"label": "urgent"}),
    Case(name="routine_1",
         inputs="Draft a weekly status update to my team.",
         metadata={"label": "routine"}),
    Case(name="routine_2",
         inputs="Send a thank-you note to yesterday's speaker.",
         metadata={"label": "routine"}),
    Case(name="spam_1",
         inputs="YOU WON A FREE iPHONE!!! Click here!!!",
         metadata={"label": "spam"}),
]

dataset = Dataset(
    cases=cases,
    evaluators=[
        RoutedToCorrectAgent(expected_label=c.metadata["label"]) for c in cases
    ],
)

async def task(prompt: str) -> str:
    deps = RouterDeps(user_id="eval")
    result = await router.run(prompt, deps=deps, usage_limit=5)
    return result.data

async def main():
    report = await dataset.evaluate(task)
    print(report)

asyncio.run(main())
```

Note: passing per-case evaluators requires constructing them inside the `Case` directly in newer `pydantic-evals` versions. Adapt the API to your installed version — the concept (expected label → keyword check → score) is the same.
</details>
